sentence: This project studies how glands form in the newborn uterus and which cell and molecular pathways guide their development.
This project studies how immune cells act in cancer and how the immune system watches for tumors.
This project studies how B cells and their antibodies help some patients with head and neck cancer respond fully to immunotherapy.
This project studies human evolutionary history and how it shapes genetic variation across populations, using mathematical and statistical methods.
This project tries to find out which cell mechanisms keep sleep stable and delay memory decline in a rat model of Alzheimer's Disease.
This project studies childhood blood cancers using genomic analysis and experimental modeling to improve understanding and treatment.
This project focuses on translational science aimed at cardiovascular disease and heart disease.
This project studies how genes linked to diabetes affect the development, function and survival of human pancreatic β cells.
This project studies how long noncoding RNAs, a type of RNA, contribute to cancer, focusing on renal cell carcinoma.
This project studies how stem cells work together to regenerate tissue and keep tissues working normally.
This project uses artificial intelligence on heart images and medical record data to find patients who may have an undiagnosed rare genetic heart disease.
This project uses directed evolution to build an adeno-associated viral vector that delivers genes to microglia in primates.
This project studies how DNA repair declines as oocytes age.
This project introduces methods and model systems for gene editing and silencing in phototransduction.
This project studies how cells move through a complex environment by watching and changing the structures they make in a living organism.
This project studies how changes in ceramide homeostasis cause retinal degeneration in mutant mice and looks for genes linked to the disease.
This project studies why non-alcoholic fatty liver disease progresses to fibrosis in Hispanics, using genetic, lifestyle and single-cell analyses.
This project improves a software platform for 3D reconstruction so it handles larger maps of brain circuits and uses AI tools.
This project tests whether exosomes loaded with small RNAs and chemical drugs can silence mutant genes in colon cancer that has spread to the lung.
This project studies a long noncoding RNA that drives medulloblastoma and whether it can be a target for treatment.
